text:
Ashley Rivera: quick idea — decouple penalty scoring from the admission controller into a thin "sidecar" so we can iterate on abuse heuristics without touching the hot admission path
Mike Chen: curious — what's the expected API and perf hit?
Leila Patel: fwiw i like the iteration angle, but RTT + cache correctness worry me
Ashley Rivera: rough sketch:
```json
POST /score
{ "tenant_id": "t-123", "recent_events": [{"type":"llm_request","tokens":120}], "req_id":"r-abc" }
// response { "score": 0.74, "version": "v2026-03-15", "valid_for_ms": 500 }
```
Mike Chen: ok. if we add a local LRU with TTL we can avoid most RTTs. still need to define fallback on sidecar timeout (soft-fail vs conservative block)
Leila Patel: preference is soft-fail -> treat as 0.5 (degrade fairness not availability). but documentably reversible. also we need strong telemetry: attach score_version and score_id to token decisions
Ashley Rivera: agreed. proposing these policies:
- default: cache hit -> use cached score
- timeout (100ms) -> soft-fail to previous_score if within window, else neutral_score (0.5)
- persistent failure -> switch to local heuristic (configurable)
Mike Chen: + instrumentation: expose prometheus metrics: sidecar_request_latency_ms, sidecar_error_rate, cache_hit_ratio, score_versions_active
Jonathan Cruz: how to handle stateful signals (e.g., per-tenant abuse rate over sliding window)? sidecar needs to accept sketches or just return score based on server-side DB?
Ashley Rivera: two modes: 1) stateless scoring using recent_events (fast) 2) enriched scoring using tenant-profile fetched async; enriched path returns versioned score and may have higher latency — admission can treat enriched scores as advisory
Leila Patel: rollout plan idea:
- canary: deploy sidecar to 5% of frontends, header X-penalty-variant identifies variant
- log both local and sidecar decisions for 2w, run offline evals against PSLs
- stage 2: soft-opt-in (only affect low-sensitivity tenants)
- stage 3: full opt-in with feature flag
Ashley Rivera: and rollback safety: if sidecar_error_rate > 2% for 5m -> auto disable sidecar scoring and revert to local heuristic, alert on-call
infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary deployment started: penalty-sidecar:v1 -> cluster canary-3 (pods:3) :rocket:
Mike Chen: config snippet for admission to call sidecar (very small):
```yaml
admission:
  penalty_source: "sidecar"
  sidecar:
    addr: "unix:///var/run/penalty.sock"
    timeout_ms: 100
    cache_ttl_ms: 500
    fallback_policy: "previous_or_neutral"
```
Leila Patel: telemetry TODOs: add score_version tag to trace, surface sample decisions in rerun job, add a dashboard for "score divergence" (local vs sidecar)
Jonathan Cruz: can we add a deterministic checksum for score logic (hash of rules + models) so rollouts are auditable?
Ashley Rivera: yes — include SCORE_BUILD_ID in response and attach to logs. add a smoke test that replays 1k synthetic events per tenant after deploy
Mike Chen: ack. i'll prototype sidecar server + lru cache this week. can we sync thursday 11am to align on metrics and rollout?
Ashley Rivera: thursday 11 works for me. thanks all :thumbsup:
Leila Patel: tagging @Jonathan Cruz to own the dashboard items
Jonathan Cruz: on it — will draft grafana panels and alert rules by friday
infra-bot: NOTE: created ticket INFRA-1942 "penalty-sidecar canary + metrics" assigned to Mike Chen
Ashley Rivera: thanks team — next: PR with basic sidecar API and admission switch (draft)
